calculation.description: Negative of the 1-day intraday move (close/open - 1); cross-asset intraday mean reversion. High values (down intraday day) predict higher next-day cross-sectional return.

validation.regime_notes: Validated on the 15-name cross-asset panel (equity indices, commodities, crypto, yields) across 2021-2026, covering the 2022 bear market, 2023-24 recovery, and 2025-26 crypto/commodity regimes. Daily 1d-forward rank IC, >=8 valid instruments/date. By-year IC1 stable: 2021:0.0615, 2022:0.0346, 2023:0.0382, 2024:0.0482, 2025:0.0662, 2026:0.0228.

provenance.computed_from: real daily OHLCV data via alphacrafter sim get_index_daily_data (no fabricated metrics)

signal_artifact.format: gzip+base64 float32 matrix (dates x symbols), NaN preserved
signal_artifact.recovery: base64.b64decode -> gzip.decompress -> np.load(npy) -> float32 (n_dates x n_symbols)
